prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign/new flow, finish new screen, home wait info/notification, and sign in hint changes as each has only one test.
Path selection layout changes (choose_path, layout) show a positive pattern across 2 tests (+1.2% and +5.6% after noise correction), with one test showing a clear winning effect.
Predictions were generally overly optimistic in Round 1, but underpredicted the Round 2 path layout winner.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -4.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +3.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: +1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Delayed Account Sign-In Flow: Move sign-in to occur after pet adoption selection so users feel invested in their chosen pet before creating or logging into an account. (why: Sign-in drops 23.1% of users early in the funnel; letting users pick their pet first builds motivation before asking for authentication.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Compatibility Check Screen: Insert a system compatibility check screen right before the waiting screen to verify GPU rendering and overlay permissions. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing on the desktop or the app failing to open during desktop load, and home median wait is 201s.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Control Sandbox Flow: Introduce a mini interactive desktop sandbox screen after home_intro where users practice summoning, hiding, and feeding their pet. (why: 3 support emails report confusion on how to control/hide/talk to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Split Layout Showcase: Change path selection layout to a split-screen view highlighting preset vs custom path benefits. (why: Path selection layout changes showed positive results in prior tests (+1.2% and +5.6%), so expanding to split layout leverages this momentum.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Hint: Add a clear recovery hint under sign-in options explaining how logging into an existing account restores previous pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in, indicating confusion around account switching vs creation.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Validation Guide: Display tips and clear photo guidelines on the upload screen to ensure high-fidelity photo generation. (why: Support received 3 emails regarding custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output, and adoption average time is high.)
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Interactive Mini Quiz: Add an interactive pet trivia widget and progress timer to the waiting screen while the pet renders. (why: Waiting screen has a long median time (201s / mean 2336s), causing drop-off or perceived freeze.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Action Cheat Sheet: Add a visual cheat sheet component on home_intro highlighting key combination shortcuts for pet interaction. (why: Multiple support emails mention post-onboarding confusion regarding how to summon, hide, or talk to the pet.)

scores.note: Sign-in drop-off is high, but reordering steps is high effort and past flow changes showed poor results.
Supported by 3 emails and long home wait times, but introducing new screens has low proven efficacy.
Finish step has high loss and support evidence, but new flow changes historically underperform.
Strong confidence from consistent positive layout test results (+1.2% and +5.6%) at choose_path.
Strongest evidence from 8 support emails, low cost hint change with prior +3.3% hint test result.
Adoption step drops nearly 40% of users; adding quality hints targets high drop-off and support issues.
Previous home wait_info test yielded +0.0% lift, making this high effort with minimal expected gain.
